Joint acceptance is unchanged at false (F402), so no candidate is selected here and this plan selects nothing; the diagnostic deferral of causal attribution (rec-defer-causal-replay) is kept separate from this search plan and is not converted into a value. Because the only two parameters under a standing grant are the tip-speed weights, the plan probes exactly those two coordinates at the fixed controller controller.gvs_nmpc@7.0.0 with the robot, task, acceptance, controller implementation and other numerical settings held fixed. Domains respect the legal rule (zero or >= 0.0001) and contain the saved starting values 0.0 and 0.05; step 0.05 moves 0.05 to 0.10/0.00 and 0.0 to 0.05, never entering the forbidden tiny-positive interval (0, 0.0001). Six candidates at 4 tool calls, 1 backend solve and 990 s each keep the planned budget within the phase's non-executing scope (backend_solves = max_candidates = 6; tool_calls 24 >= 4x6; wall_s 5940 >= 990x6; workers 0); model_calls 8 only covers bounded provider attempts and is not evidence. Objectives are joint acceptance first, then the three recorded physical metrics plus complete-update cost, because the paired comparison shows holding gains accompanied by reach and computation losses: any improvement with a worsening elsewhere is a trade-off, not overall improvement (F286), and raw weighted cost under different weights is never the final ranking (F141). Fidelity is limited by the absence of closed-loop counterfactual replay, by the 8-of-35 sampled plan view, by the final-window-only holding sampling (F101/F71, no continuous-time guarantee F185/F331), and by the fact that the late effective_horizon truncation (F640, F691, F711, F681) and budget-driven stopping (F662, F690 with User_Requested_Stop, F635 selected iteration 68 under max_iterations 120 F525) remain controller-side plan records rather than backend motion, which is exactly why the promise is only uncertain.
stopping_conditions: Stop the batch after max_candidates = 6 coordinate candidates or when the planned_budget (24 tool calls, 6 backend solves, 5940 s wall, 0 workers) is exhausted, whichever comes first.

Stop early and report success only if a candidate yields joint_reach_holding_acceptance true (holding position and speed inside the recorded limits and terminal reach retained), verified by the frozen acceptance comparison rather than by raw weighted cost.
Stop a candidate immediately on any force-bound violation, solver error, non-finite state, or invalid/incomplete execution; record it as a constraint failure rather than a physical result.

Stop and report separability as unresolved if deadline_misses remains 35 of 35 and effective_horizon stays truncated below the configured horizon 10, since weight-only coordinates then cannot be separated from compute-budget/horizon truncation.
Halt a candidate after at most two bounded provider attempts on transport failure; a transport failure is not evidence about the hypothesis.
Terminate this stage without executing any batch or promoting any candidate: a validated plan requires a future grant.
weakening_observations: The single executed weight change (holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0->0.05, F462 -> F538) moved the sampled holding max speed by only -0.4060100069642385 m/s (F301) from 1.5810152739742807 (F58) to 1.1750052670100422 (F160), still about 59x the 0.02 m/s limit (F440); a coordinate increase in the same weight may therefore be low-yield rather than settling the failure.

The same change worsened terminal reach (candidate-minus-baseline terminal_error_m +0.001056295661744434, F97; candidate 0.00869890424761182, F62) while terminal_tip_speed_weight stayed 0.0 (F454), so raising the terminal tip-speed coordinate may erode a reach margin that is already only 0.0013 m inside the 0.01 m tolerance (F456).

Computation stayed saturated and unsolved: deadline_misses is 35 of 35 updates in both runs (F90, F29; delta F153 = 0) at 0.01 s control period (F274, F76) with mean complete-update 17.77877309145406 s (F114), and the performed plans check records effective_horizon truncating to 7, 5, 3 and 1 (F640, F691, F711, F681) below the configured horizon 10 (F537), with User_Requested_Stop at updates 8 and 28 (F662, F690) under max_iterations 120 (F525); holding-cost nodes may be evaluated over a shortened horizon, so a weight coordinate may not act as the objective scaling intends.

Sampled per-channel applied tension reaches 7.999998299677138 N at update 30 (F699) against the 8.0 N per-tendon limit, so pushing tip-speed penalties harder may be limited by the force bound even though force_bound_violation_n is 0.0 in both runs (F343).

arguments.reasoning:
Recommendation disposition = defer (rec-defer-causal-replay retained, with rec-defer-weight-tuning retained alongside it): adopt nothing and assert no parameter value from the two tip-speed-weight coordinates. Basis from the exact host-bound aliases: the only executed change is control/recipe/holding_tip_speed_weight baseline_value 0.0 -> effective_value 0.05, with control/recipe/terminal_tip_speed_weight unchanged at 0.0 (F454, F462, F538); its sealed comparison is classification physical_tradeoff (F199) because candidate-minus-baseline holding_max_error_m -0.001633544566242727 m (F420) and holding_max_speed_m_s -0.4060100069642385 m/s (F301) improved while terminal_error_m +0.001056295661744434 m (F97) and mean_complete_update_s +0.5154540428891785 s (F235) worsened; joint_reach_holding_passed is false for both runs (F187, F402) and force_bound_violation_n is 0.0 in both (F134, F343). Any physical improvement accompanied by physical worsening is a trade-off, not overall improvement (F286), raw scalar objectives under different weights are not ranked (F141), and a single paired change cannot attribute a dominant settling cause; so no value is adopted and causal attribution stays deferred.

Diagnostic value and remaining uncertainty, kept separate from any value: the performed plans-view check read 8 of 35 update records and separated budget-driven termination (optimization_raw_status User_Requested_Stop, policy_stop_reason budget_best_feasible, F662/F669/F690/F684) from convergence, exposed late effective_horizon truncation to 7/5/3/1 (F640, F691, F711, F681) below the configured horizon 10 (F537) over the final holding interval, and showed sampled per-channel tensions peaking at 7.999998 N, at or below the 8.0 N per-tendon limit (F346), weakening tendon saturation; the tip-speed-penalty explanation stays unresolved because no per-term cost contributions are retained. Remaining uncertainty: those are controller-side plan records, not backend motion; 27 of 35 updates remain not_read; the holding window covers only the final 0.05 s of 6 samples (F101, F71) with continuous_time_guarantee false (F185, F331); and one execution plus one paired comparison has no closed-loop counterfactual replay (capability_unavailable). These citations are evidence, not causal truth, and validity of the citation does not establish a mechanism.

Future plan and candidate selection separated from the recommendation: the validated search plan (artifact ecde23bb45218b167ed34d52f0e4291be21201e3d7d39ebce872c9b34c0e7222) is structurally_operationally_valid true but scientific_promise uncertain with execution_authorized false and candidate_promoted false — a future plan is not an execution grant and is not evidence of physical improvement. improvement-96f0ade35119 is not an overall improvement (physical_tradeoff F199; joint acceptance false F402): terminal reach still passes (F47; candidate terminal_error_m 0.00869890424761182 m F62 inside the 0.01 m tolerance F456/F526) while holding still fails (candidate holding_max_error_m 0.05650455971948983 m F32 against 0.01 m F456; holding_max_speed_m_s 1.1750052670100422 m/s F160 against 0.02 m/s F440; holding_position_passed false F12, holding_speed_passed false F25). The frozen baseline itself also fails joint acceptance (F187), so the selection is deferred rather than settled in favor of either; no candidate is selected.
